_comment: Launch configuration for the eight Augmented Nature MCP servers (from mcp-python-ingestion examples/orchestration_demo/drug_target_discovery/mcp_client_config.json). ${SERVERS_ROOT} is replaced by --servers-root, $HPLAN_MCP_SERVERS_ROOT, or ~/mcp-servers.

opentargets-server.description: Open Targets platform for disease-target associations

uniprot-server.description: UniProt protein database for sequence and function data

reactome-server.description: Reactome pathway database for biological pathways

pdb-server.description: Protein Data Bank for experimental 3D structures

chembl-server.description: ChEMBL database for drug compounds and bioactivity

pubmed-server.description: PubMed literature database for scientific publications

kegg-server.description: KEGG pathway database for metabolic and signaling pathways
